panel.title: Column Layout
panel.reapplyHint: Apply the current preference without saving it.
panel.preference: Preference: {count} — each column uses 1/{count} of the width ({percent}%).
panel.scope: This preference belongs to this workspace. Its layout changes only while it is focused.
status.error: Layout not confirmed: communication or command failed. Use Reapply to retry.
status.floating: Layout not applied: focus a tiled window and use Reapply.
status.empty: Layout not applied: no tiled windows in this workspace.
status.focusChanged: Layout not applied: focus changed during the request. Use Reapply to retry.
status.paused: Automation paused for all workspaces in this session. You can still save preferences; an operation already started may finish.
status.saveError: Preference not saved. It remains active for this session; click the selected number to retry saving.
status.streamError: Window events unavailable. Use Reapply while automation is active; event monitoring is not confirmed.
panel.noWorkspace: Waiting for a workspace on this output.
panel.positionPersistence: After restarting, this preference uses its position on this monitor. Reordering can change the association.
